outcome: neonatal admission to the newborn nursery
cohort: The study included 50 pregnant women with singleton pregnancies suffering from Intrauterine Growth Restriction (IUGR) associated with impaired placental circulation.
finding: Sildenafil citrate treatment led to a significant decrease in umbilical artery Doppler indices and a statistically significant difference in mean birth weight at delivery and neonatal admission to the newborn nursery.
